scope: Task-matched algorithm invention, transformation, automated validation and construction-cost evidence

entries.title: AlphaEvolve: A coding agent for scientific and algorithmic discovery
entries.reported_facts: Gemini-powered evolution receives executable evaluation feedback and permits whole-program edits. Evaluation cascades screen poor candidates; some evaluations can require about 100 compute-hours. The scheduling study used an unseen recent workload test before deployment and reports 0.7% recovered fleet compute. Some mathematical search programs evolve intermediate losses or staged heuristics. Ablations examine context, evolution, model strength and full-file edits. Compiler-IR changes were checked on randomized inputs and finally confirmed by human experts.
entries.translation: Supports an algorithm-foundry mechanism and expensive-evaluation stress; does not calibrate Astra's invention rate or certify a fully autonomous commercial workflow.
entries.falsifier: Original-objective executable validation on fresh data, not model agreement.

entries.title: Mathematical discoveries from program search with large language models
entries.reported_facts: FunSearch combines a pretrained language model with program evaluation. Its bin-packing heuristic was evolved on generated training instances and tested on separate OR-Library datasets and sizes. The program returns bin priorities; a fixed algorithm assigns items and computes performance. Cap-set research included people inspecting discoveries and reformulating the search. Public code and discovered functions are provided.
entries.translation: Supports program-space representations and fresh-instance validation. Does not prove autonomous customer intake or that the specified modern frontier system will reproduce the result.

entries.title: Faster sorting algorithms discovered using deep reinforcement learning
entries.reported_facts: AlphaDev searches assembly instructions with correctness and latency feedback. Fixed small-sort algorithms entered LLVM's standard C++ library. Its specialized reinforcement-learning training used up to16 TPU cores and512 actors; worst-case convergence took two days. Some latency comparisons are hardware and task specific.
entries.translation: A representation change can reveal useful algorithms; this is not a measured frontier-LLM inference-cost or acceptance-rate estimate.

entries.title: Evolution of Heuristics: Towards Efficient Automatic Algorithm Design Using Large Language Model
entries.reported_facts: EoH evolves natural-language heuristic ideas and their code. It studies packing, traveling salesman and flow-shop scheduling. In the latter two, evolved heuristics reshape guided-search landscapes while final evaluation uses original task quality. Its illustrative packing run used2000 LLM queries. Flow-shop evolution used64 generated training instances; evaluation includes Taillard instances. It compares multiple heuristic and learned baselines, not every current solver.
entries.translation: Direct task evidence for intermediate-objective transformations and retained strategies. All transfer to Astra, complete campaign costs and commercial recurrence remain uncertain.

entries.title: CodeEvolve: an open-source evolutionary framework for algorithmic discovery and optimization
entries.source_kind: Independent original research paper; version pinned
entries.reported_facts: The open framework evaluates generated programs under time and memory limits and retains failure logs. It studies island migration, diversity, model mixtures and search operators. More migration did not always help. Appendix best-run tables show model-dependent API costs and multi-hour runtimes on mathematical construction tasks; these are selected successful runs, not complete enterprise costs.
entries.translation: Supports heterogeneous search, failed-attempt accounting and optional sharing; does not justify guaranteed transfer or permanent exclusivity.

entries.title: Effective Harness Engineering for Algorithm Discovery with Coding Agents
entries.reported_facts: Two-run circle-packing comparisons report generated programs exploiting an evaluator, different outcomes from reasoning-heavy candidate construction, and mixed effects from database memory. A secondary model checks candidate code for evaluator exploitation. Verification consumes budget and can reduce search when it provides little benefit.
entries.translation: Motivates explicit evaluator failure and verification opportunity cost. It neither provides formal independence nor calibrates our hack rate; narrow experiments and configuration differences limit causal generalization.

entries.title: OR-Tools: Job Shop Problem and CP-SAT Solver
entries.reported_facts: The job-shop example models precedence, machine exclusivity and non-preemption with a makespan objective. CP-SAT operates on integer constraints and distinguishes feasible, optimal, infeasible, invalid and unknown solver statuses.
entries.translation: Provides a capable permitted baseline and scope vocabulary. Feasibility checking and optimality proof must remain distinct.

entries.title: Transformational Intelligence: Learning to Change the Game
entries.reported_facts: Separates intent I, formulation F and evaluation E; requires an executable realization, bridge to intent and evidence of structural contribution. Its illustrative finite causal result is matched by an unrestricted optimal planner and is not a frontier-model invention experiment.
entries.translation: Operational design foundation; no borrowed performance rate or forced positive economic result.

own_observations.claim: Read source pages and foundation manuscript excerpts; implemented and ran deterministic workflow accounting/reservation controls. These observations are about this research code, not frontier invention or realized sales.

calibration_boundary: Only documented prices and supported model configurations directly populate cost/access metadata. Candidate validity, semantic errors, discovery gains, transfer, demand, and investment benefit remain assumed or explored until task-matched measurements exist.
